run_rl_training: run RL training for a selected environment with configurable parameters and wandb metrics tracking
test_inference_environment: test an RL environment's inference pipeline with multiple models before starting full training
list_rl_environments: list all available RL environments discovered by scanning the tinker-atropos environments directory
edit_rl_config: edit RL training configuration fields like group_size, total_steps, and wandb_project for the selected environment
check_rl_training_status: check the status and wandb metrics of a running RL training job by run id
